description_en: When you use the client-side rendering SDK, call this API with the license issued by the platform to obtain the authentication token required for SDK integration
description_zh: 使用端渲染sdk时，使用平台下发的license许可证调用该接口，换取端渲染sdk接入时需要的鉴权token
name: LicenseAuth

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. Obtain this ID from the developer information in the service configuration on the Digitized Virtual Human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台的对应业务配置的开发者信息中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The AppId. Obtain this ID from the developer information in the service configuration on the Digitized Virtual Human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: AppId，从虚拟数字人开放平台的对应业务配置的开发者信息中获取的AppId
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The content of the license file. This file is generated after you attach the client package name. Download the license file for the instance from its configuration
parameters.help_zh: 后台绑定客户端包名信息后生成的license文件中的内容，可以从实例配置中去下载对应实例的license文件
parameters.name: license
